products.name: Raven
products.description: A narrative interpretation engine that helps you examine your own patterns through structured reflection. Raven reads your inputs — journal entries, decisions, recurring tensions — and surfaces the threads you might not see on your own. Currently in development.

products.name: The Woven Map
products.description: A dynamic, evolving personal record built from what Raven surfaces. Not a static chart or a personality label — a living map of your patterns, cycles, and growth edges that updates as you do. Currently in development.
